dedupe_keys.name: peoplesun nigerian household and enterprise energy audits

description: Reiner Lemoine Institut and eHealth Africa publish anonymised household and enterprise energy-audit data from rural Nigeria through the PeopleSuN project. The repository separates household and enterprise records, appliances, equipment and stoves, and includes an anonymised geographic key. Excel codebooks and response-choice tables document the survey variables. Public tab-delimited files are unrestricted and free under the Open Data Commons Attribution 1.0 licence. The records can inform electricity-demand, appliance-adoption and supply-reliability assumptions in planning or agent-based studies linked to model-pypsa. A caveat is that these are survey responses, not continuous smart-meter observations, and anonymisation limits precise spatial linkage. The inspected repository description does not establish the complete fieldwork dates or sampling weights. Users should consult the codebooks and sampling documentation before extrapolating to other Nigerian communities. No respondent-level data were downloaded or analysed.
